verdict: Bankruptcy delisting, last trade 2020-10-29, OTC HTZGQ from 2020-10-30; library right except price_ticker HTZ should be HTZGQ.

verification.notes: The 8-K filed 2020-10-30 (0001657853-20-000104) says the common stock traded OTC from 2020-10-30 under HTZGQ, and that the NYSE symbol was HTZ. The Form 25-NSE (0000876661-20-001005) confirms trading was suspended after the close on 2020-10-29. The reference rule for otc_print uses the security's own OTC symbol and the session after the last trade, so price_ticker HTZGQ with price_date 2020-10-30 is right. Fails rows for CUSIP 42806J106 exist under HTZGQ from 2020-11-03. One minor error in report section 5: it says 18 fails rows, but the cache shows 36 rows through 2020-12-31. No field depends on that count.
